messages:
deploy-bot: r2026.03.20-8 deploy completed to eu1/apac1/us1, starting post-deploy smoke checks
maya: apac embed synth failing intermittently, ~7/30 failures, p95 latency +120ms :thinking_face:
leo: share the synth dashboard? want error shape before any rollout decision
maya: https://grafana.redwood/synth/apac/embed - spike at 21:04 UTC, payloads returning 5xx/timeouts
samir: paste a failing curl/response? need to see headers and proxy code paths
maya: sample:
```
curl -X POST https://apac1.redwood/synth/embed -H 'x-deploy-id: r2026.03.20-8' -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'
# result: HTTP 504 after 30s
```
jing: we increased batching window from 10ms -> 25ms in this rollout to improve throughput, might be queueing short requests
raja: batching usually raises latency, but 5xx suggests upstream timeouts or model-side warm start issues
opsbot: alert created: INC-2026-045 - apac embed synth timeouts (created by smokewatch)
maya: proxy traces show upstream timeout, lots of kvcache.miss and model.warm_start entries in logs
samir: hypothesis: larger batch window + cold kv cache -> queue grows and model instances hit warm-start penalty -> timeouts
leo: can we repro by pointing the probe at the previous model variant in apac? quick A/B to isolate variant vs config
maya: ran quick probe against v3f-stable: 30/30 success, p95 within baseline
leo: isolates to new variant/config in this deploy
options: 1) rollback apac to previous variant, 2) revert batching window in apac, 3) pin apac traffic to old variant while triaging, 4) global rollback
raja: avoid global rollback if regional. routing supports per-region pinning
samir: pin is fastest. use rbctl to pin apac embed to v3f-stable, takes ~2m to propagate
jing: reverting batching requires deploy; pin is lower risk and immediate
leo: are any dedicated customers impacted? looks like only hosted traffic in apac smoke probes failed
maya: running pin now:
```
rbctl pin --region apac --service embed --to v3f-stable --note "post-deploy synth timeouts"
```
deploy-bot: pin request accepted, rollout to apac started (rbctl job 6721)
opsbot: SR-6721 created and assigned to samir
samir: monitoring the synthetic probe and real traffic in apac, watching error rate
maya: after pin: failures drop to 0/30, p95 back to baseline :tada:
leo: decision: pause the global rollout for 30m and triage batching/warm-start interaction; no global rollback
jing: I'll add a region-scoped staging probe and update release notes to call out batching window change
raja: filing follow-up ticket to stress-test warm-start under larger batch windows and KV miss patterns
maya: filed TICKET-APAC-356 with logs, timeline, and reproducer steps
samir: INC-2026-045 marked mitigated by pin, will monitor for 1h then consider unpause
leo: add a canary with higher synthetic sample rate in apac for next deploy so we catch this earlier
deploy-bot: global rollouts paused by leo (rollout_pause=true)
maya: linking runbook: docs/runbooks/synth-smoke and the probe config PR for batching changes
jing: will follow up with postmortem if config is root cause
raja: schedule a focused perf run next week to validate kv warm-start under 25ms batch window
samir: no new failures in last 20m, keeping SR-6721 open for follow-up
maya: thanks team — marking this thread resolved for now, keep watch on the SDK and customer-facing dashboards
